rest.name: confluence
rest.description: Read Fiska Confluence. GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces, /wiki/api/v2/pages, /wiki/api/v2/pages/PAGE_ID with body-format=storage; search via GET /wiki/rest/api/search with query.cql. Paths and query arguments are separate. Follow response link pagination using the same tool. Writes are disabled.

rest.name: cloudflare_fiska_com
rest.description: Read Cloudflare zone data for fiska.com. Start with GET /zones with query.name=fiska.com; then GET /zones/ZONE_ID/dns_records, /settings, or /analytics/dashboard. Preserve result_info pagination. The token limits access to this zone. Writes are disabled.
